text_block_list.text:
With the Tenno Sho (Spring) drawing near 
and the days flying by in a blur, Symboli 
Rudolf was once again busy handling media 
interviews today.

Meanwhile, wishing for the prosperity of 
the Umamusume world, she boldly proclaims 
the staging of the "Fan Grand Appreciation 
Festival."

There is a haunting intensity to Symboli 
Rudolf right now. Following the incident 
with Air Groove, she has become obsessed 
with winning an even stronger trust.

Work harder, run harder, and display the 
absolute perfection of the "Emperor." That 
was the answer of a Symboli Rudolf who 
still recognized her own immaturity.
